source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.4.3, printed page 308.

blocks.text: Sulphur ke do oxides hain: sulphur dioxide (SO₂) aur sulphur trioxide (SO₃); in dono ko mil kar SOₓ kehte hain. Yeh gases zyada tar coal aur oil jalne se hawa mein aati hain. Jab SOₓ paani ke bukharat (water vapour) se milti hai to acid rain banti hai, jo ecosystem (jandaron aur mahol ka nizam) ko nuqsan deti hai. Hawa mein acid deposition (tezab ka zameen par jamna) ka sab se bara source SO₂ hai.

blocks.prompt: SO₃ ke bajaye SO₂ ko acid deposition ka bara source kyun kaha jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Coal aur oil jalne par sulphur zyada tar SO₂ ki shakal mein nikalta hai; is ka sirf ek hissa baad mein hawa mein SO₃ banta hai. Is liye jo acid zameen par girta hai us ki miqdar asal mein kharij hone wali SO₂ par munhasir hai.

items: SOₓ = SO₂ + SO₃, coal aur oil jalne se; paani ke bukharat se mil kar acid rain; SO₂ acid deposition ka bara source.
